answer: Jade-seal escrow: every identity locks a jade token as a refundable bond before it may trade, and each bond is tied to one relic, a unique verifiable work artifact the agent produced, such as a signed computation trace. Pigment-marked reputation accrues only to bonded relics, and a Sybil operator must fund a fresh bond plus a fresh relic per fake, while honest agents reuse one. Slashing burns the bond of any relic caught double-signing, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and a thousand relics.
